headword: {原子力発電所|げんしりょくはつでんしょ}
reading: げんしりょくはつでんしょ

definitions.gloss: nuclear power plant; nuclear power station
definitions.explanation: A power station that generates electricity from nuclear fission. In speech and news it is almost always shortened to {原発|げんぱつ}, which since the 2011 Fukushima accident has been at the center of political debate.

examples.english: The nuclear power plant shut down.
